object.dimensions includes object scale but is stale right after setting scale: it reads (2,2,2) until view_layer.update(), then (4,2,2); the mesh coordinates do not change
mesh.transform(Matrix.Diagonal(scale)) then scale=(1,1,1) applies scale with the data API
bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True) works headless on the selected objects
transform_apply on an object whose mesh has 2 users fails
facts.result: RuntimeError: Error: Cannot apply to a multi user: Object "Cube.002", Mesh "Cube.002", aborting

facts.fact: a Solidify of thickness 0.1 on an object scaled 3x is 0.3 thick in the world (modifier values are in object space)
scene unit scale_length 0.01 does not change the size of new primitives (it changes only displayed units)
